stances_toward.note: Constituent country since 10 Oct 2010 (shared island with French Saint-Martin); foreign relations and defence are Kingdom affairs. The Hague's leverage is the Charter's Kingdom Acts, which the local parliament can contest only by raising the required majority to 5/9. Own territory, with its own government. Bond - kin.

relations_to.summary: Sint Maarten became a constituent country of the Kingdom on 10 Oct 2010 (shared island with French Saint-Martin); foreign relations and defence are Kingdom affairs, and the Kingdom Acts of the Charter let The Hague legislate for it.
